splitTopLevelComma.name: a comma inside a heredoc is text
a tagged heredoc hides a comma and a paren
a quote inside a heredoc opens no string
a line comment hides a comma
a block comment hides a comma and a paren
heredoc markers inside a string are text
a $$ that no $$ closes opens no heredoc

findTopLevelSQLPattern.name: skips a keyword inside a heredoc
findTopLevelSQLPattern.sql: x ORDER BY $$ SETTINGS $$ SETTINGS a=1

findTopLevelSQLPattern.name: skips a keyword inside a block comment
findTopLevelSQLPattern.sql: MergeTree ORDER BY id /* SETTINGS */ SETTINGS x=1

findTopLevelSQLPattern.name: skips a keyword inside a line comment
findTopLevelSQLPattern.sql:
ORDER BY id -- SETTINGS a=1
SETTINGS b=2

findTopLevelSQLPattern.name: skips a delimiter inside a # comment
a quote inside a heredoc opens no string
a paren inside a heredoc is text
a keyword inside a string is still skipped
no match outside heredocs and comments

normalizeProjectionIndex.name: a heredoc with a comma and a comment marker stays one element
a comma inside a heredoc gets no space
a lone heredoc element keeps its literal
commas outside heredocs still get a space
